prompt: Draw an AWS architecture diagram of our shop backend: the React web app is served from S3 through CloudFront; customers sign in with Cognito; the app calls API Gateway, which invokes a Lambda 'orders-api' that reads and writes a DynamoDB table 'orders'. When an order is placed, orders-api puts an event on EventBridge; a rule sends it to an SQS queue, a 'fulfil' Lambda consumes the queue and emails the customer through SES.

Draw the AWS network diagram for our three-tier web app in eu-west-1: Route 53 points at an Application Load Balancer in public subnets across two Availability Zones; ECS Fargate tasks run in private subnets in both AZs; Aurora PostgreSQL has a writer in AZ a and a reader in AZ b in isolated database subnets; each AZ has a NAT gateway for outbound traffic; the tasks upload files to S3 through a VPC gateway endpoint.

Draw an AWS diagram of our internal document Q&A assistant: staff use a web chat that calls API Gateway (WebSocket) -> a Lambda 'chat-handler' -> Amazon Bedrock (Claude) using a Bedrock Knowledge Base. The knowledge base indexes PDFs that land in an S3 bucket 'docs' and stores vectors in OpenSearch Serverless. Conversation history is kept in DynamoDB. Show the ingestion path separately from the question path.

Diagram our AWS clickstream pipeline: the website sends events to Kinesis Data Streams; a Lambda enriches them and writes Parquet to an S3 data lake (raw and curated prefixes); a nightly Glue job turns raw into curated; analysts query curated data with Athena and build dashboards in QuickSight. CloudWatch alarms on the Kinesis iterator age.

Draw a sequence diagram of the OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow with PKCE for our mobile app: the user, the mobile app, the system browser, the authorization server, and our API. Include the code_verifier / code_challenge steps, the redirect back with the code, the token exchange, and the API call with the access token.

Draw a state machine for an order in our shop: pending payment, paid, packing, shipped, delivered, plus cancelled and refunded. Payment can fail (back to pending, at most 3 retries, then cancelled). Orders can be cancelled until they are shipped; delivered orders can be refunded within 30 days.

Draw a flowchart for our on-call incident triage: an alert fires; if it is a known flaky alert, silence it and file a ticket; otherwise check whether customers are affected. If yes, declare an incident (SEV1 if payments are down, else SEV2), page the incident commander and post in #status. If no, investigate within 4 hours. Every incident ends with a postmortem.
Redraw the Mermaid diagram in platform.mmd as a clean, presentable architecture diagram for our engineering docs.
